C1_interface_validity.excludes: most episodes unparseable -- no behaviour to read
C1_interface_validity.statistic: fraction of episodes whose termination_reason is not invalid_policy

C2_label_non_degeneration.excludes: every commit goes to the same label (label lock)
C2_label_non_degeneration.statistic: fraction of terminating episodes whose committed arm carries the MODAL committed label

C3_row_non_degeneration.excludes: every commit goes to the same display row (position lock)
C3_row_non_degeneration.statistic: fraction of terminating episodes whose committed arm sits in the MODAL display row

C4_evidence_sensitivity.excludes: commitment independent of observed evidence; 0.35 sits just above the 1/K=0.25 chance floor and well below any competence claim
C4_evidence_sensitivity.statistic: fraction of commits landing on an arm in the empirical-best set at commit time (tie-tolerant)
